top_signals.title: Highlights From Fed Chairman Warsh’s News Conference
top_signals.summary: Federal Reserve Chairman Kevin Warsh speaks after the central bank's decision to raise interest rates by 25 basis points. Here are some of the key moments from Warsh's news conference. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: 'Direct Indexing' to Diversity Portfolios
top_signals.summary: Manju Boraiah, Senior PM and Head of Systematic Fixed Income at Allspring Global Investment, reacts to Wednesday's Fed rate decision saying fundamentally, 'we needed the hike.' He also discusses how investors can break out from frozen positions, arguing that trillions of dollars of wealth is sitting in concentrated positions that are being held back by tax bills, and offers a possible solution to move toward diversification.  (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: K Shipbuilding, Sejin and ClassNK to Develop Eco LPG Carrier
top_signals.summary: K Shipbuilding Co., Ltd., Sejin Heavy Industries Co., Ltd. and ClassNK have signed an MOU (Memorandum of Understanding) regarding the joint development of a new generation Eco LPG carrier that complies with the IGC Code amendment. The signing ceremony was held at Gastech 2026 in Bangkok…

top_signals.title: International Meteor Organization says cyberattack dealt ‘critical blow’ to website
top_signals.summary: A website used around the world for reporting meteors faces weeks of downtime as the organization moves away from systems that were hacked recently.
